description: Read data from an existing UBL/CII XML or ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF. Returns JSON business terms keyed by BT/BG numbers, CSV with one row per line, or a DATEV Buchungsstapel (EXTF). Does not validate the invoice. Suited to accounting import or data analysis. Supports UBL, CII and ZUGFeRD/Factur-X only. DATEV export has hard limits: EUR only, one invoice per file, issue date inside the fiscal year, and no booking of prepayments, rounding or Skonto. DATEV output is written to the documented layout and was not tested against a DATEV installation. B2B only. Requires the caller's own Electronic Invoice API key, sent either directly as Authorization: Bearer eia_live_... or through an OAuth 2.1 access token issued by this server. A call that reaches the API and returns 200, 400, 422 or 504 counts against the plan quota.

attachments.description: json only: include embedded files as base64.

content.description: Raw invoice XML as UTF-8 text (UBL Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII). For XML invoices only. XML extracted from a PDF is checked without the PDF container; send PDFs through file or contentBase64. Exactly one of file, content and contentBase64 is required.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded raw bytes of an invoice XML or PDF file. For PDFs and binary-safe XML when file is not available. Exactly one of file, content and contentBase64 is required.

contentType.description: Optional MIME type of the supplied document. Defaults to application/xml for content and to a value derived from filename for contentBase64. Ignored for file, where the file content decides.

datevBookingKeys.description: datev only, optional: BU-Schluessel per VAT category and rate, for example S19=9,S7=8.

datevChartOfAccounts.description: datev only, optional: Sachkontenrahmen, for example 03 or 04.

datevCounterAccount.description: datev only, required: personal account (creditor or debtor), digits only.

datevDirection.description: datev only, required: incoming (expense) or outgoing (revenue).

datevDueDate.description: datev only, optional: write the due date into the DATEV field Faelligkeit.

datevFiscalYearStart.description: datev only, required: start of the fiscal year as YYYY-MM-DD. The year of the document date is derived from it.

datevLabel.description: datev only, optional: Bezeichnung, at most 30 characters.

datevLedgerAccount.description: datev only, required: expense or revenue account, digits only.

delimiter.description: csv only: field delimiter. Default semicolon.

file.description: The invoice file the user attached in ChatGPT. The server fetches the original bytes and passes them on unchanged, so a PDF is checked as a whole, including its container. Only for clients that provide file references. Exactly one of file, content and contentBase64 is required.

download_url.description: Temporary download URL provided by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name provided by ChatGPT.

mime_type.description: MIME type provided by ChatGPT. Not trusted, the file content decides.

filename.description: Optional original filename, for example rechnung.xml or rechnung.pdf. It is used only to derive the result filename and is not sent to the API.

format.description: Output. json returns the EN 16931 term model plus a summary. csv returns one row per line. datev returns a DATEV Buchungsstapel (EXTF, Windows-1252). Default json.

labels.description: json only: add a map from BT number to xr element name.

name: extract_invoice
title: Extract e-invoice data
